If an enemy model (excluding AIRCRAFT) ends any kind of move within 9" of a Cult Ambush marker you placed, that Cult Ambush marker is removed from the battlefield. linkedRules.name: Cult Ambush
linkedRules.description:
If your Army Faction is Genestealer Cults, you start the battle with a number of Resurgence points, depending on the battle size, as shown below.

- Incursion: 6 Resurgence points
- Strike Force: 10 Resurgence points
- Onslaught: 14 Resurgence points

Each time a unit from your army is destroyed, if every model in that unit has this ability you can spend the relevant number of Resurgence points shown below based on that unit's Starting Strength.

---Aberrants---
5 models = 4 Resurgence Points
10 models = 8 Resurgence Points

---Acolyte Hybrids with Autopistols, Acolyte Hybrids with Hand Flamers, Hybrid Metamorphs---
5 models = 2 Resurgence Points
10 models = 4 Resurgence Points

---Atalan Jackals---
5 models = 2 Resurgence Points
10 models = 6 Resurgence Points

---Neophyte Hybrids---
10 models = 3 Resurgence Points
20 models = 6 Resurgence Points

---Purestrain Genestealers---
5 models = 2 Resurgence Points
10 models = 6 Resurgence Points

If you do:
- Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Cult Ambush, at its Starting Strength, with all of its wounds remaining and any [ONE SHOT] weapons those models are equipped with considered as not having been shot.
- Place one Cult Ambush marker (see below) anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" horizontally away from all enemy units (if this is not possible, not marker is placed).

UNITS IN CULT AMBUSH
Cult Ambush is a type of Strategic Reserves. Units in Cult Ambush cannot be targeted with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem, but can be set up on the battlefield using a Cult Ambush marker as described below, or by following the rules for Strategic Reserves in a subsequent turn.

CULT AMBUSH MARKERS
Use a circular 32mm diameter marker for Cult Ambush markers. If an enemy model (excluding AIRCRAFT) ends any kind of move within 9" of a Cult Ambush marker you placed, that Cult Ambush marker is removed from the battlefield. At the end of the Reinforcements step of your opponent's next Movement phase, for each of your Cult Ambush markers still on the battlefield, you can select one unit from your army that is in Cult Ambush and set up that unit using that Cult Ambush marker. To do so, set that unit up on the battlefield more than 9" horizontally away from all enemy units, with at least one model in that unit touching that Cult Ambush marker and all other models placed wholly within 3" of that Cult Ambush marker (that Cult Ambush marker is then removed from the battlefield).

linkedRules.description:
If your Army Faction is Genestealer Cults, you start the battle with a number of Resurgence points, depending on the battle size, as shown below.

- Incursion: 6 Resurgence points
- Strike Force: 10 Resurgence points
- Onslaught: 14 Resurgence points

Each time a unit from your army is destroyed, if every model in that unit has this ability you can spend the relevant number of Resurgence points shown below based on that unit's Starting Strength.

---Aberrants---
5 models = 4 Resurgence Points
10 models = 8 Resurgence Points

---Acolyte Hybrids with Autopistols, Acolyte Hybrids with Hand Flamers, Hybrid Metamorphs---
5 models = 2 Resurgence Points
10 models = 4 Resurgence Points

---Atalan Jackals---
5 models = 2 Resurgence Points
10 models = 6 Resurgence Points

---Neophyte Hybrids---
10 models = 3 Resurgence Points
20 models = 6 Resurgence Points

---Purestrain Genestealers---
5 models = 2 Resurgence Points
10 models = 6 Resurgence Points

If you do:
- Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Cult Ambush, at its Starting Strength, with all of its wounds remaining and any [ONE SHOT] weapons those models are equipped with considered as not having been shot.
- Place one Cult Ambush marker (see below) anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" horizontally away from all enemy units (if this is not possible, not marker is placed).

UNITS IN CULT AMBUSH
Cult Ambush is a type of Strategic Reserves. Units in Cult Ambush cannot be targeted with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem, but can be set up on the battlefield using a Cult Ambush marker as described below, or by following the rules for Strategic Reserves in a subsequent turn.

CULT AMBUSH MARKERS
Use a circular 32mm diameter marker for Cult Ambush markers. If an enemy model (excluding AIRCRAFT) ends any kind of move within 9" of a Cult Ambush marker you placed, that Cult Ambush marker is removed from the battlefield. At the end of the Reinforcements step of your opponent's next Movement phase, for each of your Cult Ambush markers still on the battlefield, you can select one unit from your army that is in Cult Ambush and set up that unit using that Cult Ambush marker. To do so, set that unit up on the battlefield more than 9" horizontally away from all enemy units, with at least one model in that unit touching that Cult Ambush marker and all other models placed wholly within 3" of that Cult Ambush marker (that Cult Ambush marker is then removed from the battlefield).

UNITS IN CULT AMBUSH
Cult Ambush is a type of Strategic Reserves. Units in Cult Ambush cannot be targeted with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem, but can be set up on the battlefield using a Cult Ambush marker as described below, or by following the rules for Strategic Reserves in a subsequent turn.

CULT AMBUSH MARKERS
Use a circular 32mm diameter marker for Cult Ambush markers. If an enemy model (excluding AIRCRAFT) ends any kind of move within 9" of a Cult Ambush marker you placed, that Cult Ambush marker is removed from the battlefield. At the end of the Reinforcements step of your opponent's next Movement phase, for each of your Cult Ambush markers still on the battlefield, you can select one unit from your army that is in Cult Ambush and set up that unit using that Cult Ambush marker. rules.description:
You can include Astra Militarum units in your army, even though they do not have the Genestealer Cult Faction keyword. The combined points cost of such units you can include in your army is:

- Incursion: Up to 500 pts
- Strike Force: Up to 1000 pts
- Onslaught: Up to 1500 pts

You cannot include units with any of the following keywords in your army using this rule: Aircraft; Commisar; Epic Hero; Militarum Tempestus; Ogryn; Ratling; Tech-Priest Enginseer; Ministorum Priest.

rules.name: Integrated Tactics
rules.description: Each time an Astra Militarum unit from your army is selected to shoot, you can select one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to that unit. If you do, until the end of the phase, models in that Astra Militarum unit can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target) and that enemy unit is caught in overlapping fire. While an enemy unit is caught in overlapping fire, each time a Genestealer Cult model from your army targets that enemy unit with a ranged attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

rules.description:

- Incursion: Up to 500 pts

- Onslaught: Up to 1500 pts

Catalyst (Aura): While an enemy unit is within 6" of this unit, each time a friendly GENESTEALER CULTS unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll.

rules.description: Each time a ranged attack targets a Great Devourer unit from your army, if the attacking model is not within 6" of that unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

If you are using fast dice rolling, this Stratagem can still be used after rolling multiple rolls or saving throws at once.
stratagems.target: That unit or model from your army.
stratagems.effect: You re-roll that roll, test or saving throw. If you are using fast dice rolling, select one of those rolls or saving throws to re-roll.
stratagems.legend: A great commander can bend even the vagaries of fate and fortune to their will, the better to ensure victory.

stratagems.name: GO TO GROUND
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, all models in your unit have a 6+ invulnerable save and have the Benefit of Cover.
stratagems.legend: Seeking salvation from incoming fire, warriors hurl themselves into whatever cover they can find.

stratagems.name: INSANE BRAVERY
stratagems.when: Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just before you take a Battle-shock test for a unit from your army.
stratagems.target: That unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Your unit automatically passes that Battle-shock test.
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per battle.
stratagems.legend: Indifferent to their own survival, these warriors hold their ground against seemingly impossible odds.

stratagems.name: EPIC CHALLENGE
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a CHARACTER unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more Attached units is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: One CHARACTER model in your unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, all melee attacks made by that model have the [PRECISION] ability.
stratagems.legend: The legends of the 41st Millennium are replete with deadly duels between mighty champions.

stratagems.name: HEROIC INTERVENTION
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Charge move.
stratagems.target: One unit from your army that is within 6" of that enemy unit and would be eligible to declare a charge against that enemy unit if it were your Charge phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit now declares a charge that targets only that enemy unit, and you resolve that charge as if it were your Charge phase.
stratagems.restrictions: You can only select a VEHICLE unit from your army if it is a WALKER. Note that even if this charge is successful, your unit does not receive any Charge bonus this turn.
stratagems.legend: Voices raised in furious war cries, your warriors surge forth to meet the enemy's onslaught head-on.

stratagems.name: COUNTER-OFFENSIVE
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has fought.
stratagems.target: One unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and that has not already been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit fights next.
stratagems.legend: In close-quarters combat, the slightest hesitation can leave an opening for a swift foe to exploit.

stratagems.name: TANK SHOCK
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just after a VEHICLE unit from your army ends a Charge move.
stratagems.target: That VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit, and select one VEHICLE model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit. Roll a number of D6 equal to the Toughness characteristic of the selected VEHICLE model. For each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).
stratagems.legend: Ramming the foe with a speeding vehicle may be an unsubtle tactic, but it is a murderously effective one.

stratagems.name: RAPID INGRESS
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One unit from your army that is in Reserves.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can arrive on the battlefield as if it were the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase, and if every model in that unit has the Deep Strike ability, you can set that unit up as described in the Deep Strike ability (even though it is not your Movement phase).
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem to enable a unit to arrive on the battlefield during a battle round it would not normally be able to do so in.
stratagems.legend: Be it cunning strategy, potent technology or supernatural ritual, there are many means by which a commander may hasten their warriors' onset.

stratagems.name: FIRE OVERWATCH
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement or Charge phase, just after an enemy unit is set up or when an enemy unit starts or ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, or declares a charge.
stratagems.target: One unit from your army that is within 24" of that enemy unit and that would be eligible to shoot if it were your Shooting phase.
stratagems.effect: If that enemy unit is visible to your unit, your unit can shoot that enemy unit as if it were your Shooting phase.
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot target a TITANIC unit with this Stratagem. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 6 is required to score a hit, irrespective of the attacking weapon's Ballistic Skill or any modifiers. You can only use this Stratagem once per turn.
stratagems.legend: A hail of wildfire can drive back advancing foes.

stratagems.name: GRENADE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One GRENADES unit from your army (excluding units that Advanced, Fell Back or have shot this turn) that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Select one GRENADES model in your unit and one enemy unit that is not within Engagement Range of any units from your army and is within 8" of and visible to your GRENADES model. Roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
stratagems.legend: Priming their hand-held projectiles, these warriors draw back and hurl death into the enemy's midst.

stratagems.name: SMOKESCREEN
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One SMOKE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, all models in your unit have the Benefit of Cover and the Stealth ability.
stratagems.legend: Even the most skilled marksmen struggle to hit targets veiled by billowing screens of smoke.

stratagems.name: NEW ORDERS
stratagems.when: End of your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One of your active Secondary Mission cards.
stratagems.effect: Discard it and draw one new Secondary Mission card.
stratagems.legend: High command has received new intelligence.

stratagems.name: STIMULATED BIO-SURGE
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Aberrants, Biophagus or Purestrain Genestealers unit from your army that has not declared a charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit declares a charge, if the closest eligible enemy unit is selected as one of the targets of that charge, add 1 to the Charge roll for each selected target of that charge (including the closest eligible enemy unit), to a maximum of +3.
stratagems.legend: Triggered by xenos bio-stimms flooding their bodies, when the cult's predators spring their trap, the jaws close inescapably.

stratagems.name: GENE-TWISTED MUSCLE
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Aberrants, Biophagus or Purestrain Genestealers unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE, add 1 to the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: The raw strength of those infused with the Patriarch's distilled power is undeniable when directed against the foe's hulking tools of tyranny.

stratagems.name: HYPER-METABOLIC VIGOUR
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Aberrants, Biophagus or Purestrain Genestealers unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3". In addition, it does not need to end that move closer to the closest enemy model, provided it ends it as close as possible to the closest enemy unit.
stratagems.legend: Evidence of the bio-horror taint in their veins, the most blessed of a cult exhibit an inhuman swiftness.

stratagems.name: SAINTLY PAROXYSM
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit destroys a Genestealer Cults Character model from your army.
stratagems.target: That destroyed CHARACTER model. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Roll one D6: on a 2+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. If that Character model is an Abominant or Patriarch, that enemy unit suffers 2D3 mortal wounds instead.
stratagems.legend: There are few more holy virtues in the cult's eyes than to use one's final act to lay low the oppressor.

stratagems.name: BIO-HORROR REVELATION
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent's Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Aberrants, Biophagus or Purestrain Genestealers unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit within 9" of your unit is selected to shoot, it must take a Leadership test, subtracting 1 from the result. If that test is failed, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack that targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
stratagems.legend: Face to face with hideous genetic monstrosities, their full horror can shake even the most stoic soul.

stratagems.name: EVASIVE VANGUARD
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit ends a move within 9" of one or more of your Cult Ambush markers, before removing those markers from the battlefield.
stratagems.target: Select one of those Cult Ambush markers.
stratagems.effect: You can set up that Cult Ambush marker anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" horizontally away from all enemy units.
stratagems.legend: Adaptive and intelligent, the purest of a cult's broods can evade their foes to find new avenues of ingress.

stratagems.name: SYMBIOTIC DESTRUCTION
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Astra Militarum and one GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army that have not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit that is visible to both of those selected units and within range of at least one ranged weapon from each of those units. Until the end of the phase, models in those units can only make attacks that target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target). When doing so, each time such a model makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.
stratagems.legend: As the Broodmind coordinates their timing, martial and insurrectionist comrades target their chosen victims in volleys of mutually supportive firepower.

stratagems.name: A DARK NETWORK
stratagems.when: Reinforcements step of your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is set up on the battlefield from Reserves.
stratagems.target: One Astra Militarum or GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) within 12" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
stratagems.legend: Forewarned of the enemy's sudden onset by spies in their ranks or by the Brood Brothers' own strategos, the cult's faithful evade potential catastrophe.

stratagems.name: ACCEPTABLE LOSSES
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Astra Militarum unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of one or more GENESTEALER CULTS units from your army. Until the end of the phase, your unit can make ranged attacks that target that enemy unit. If it does, after it has resolved those attacks, roll one D6 for each of those GENESTEALER CULTS units: on a 5+, the unit being rolled for suffers D3+1 mortal wounds.
stratagems.legend: With martial pragmatism and the cult's victory at stake, Brood Brothers will willingly open fire on the foe even if it endangers infiltrating cells of allies.

stratagems.name: SUPPRESS AND OVERWHELM
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after an Astra Militarum unit from your army has shot.
stratagems.target: That ASTRA MILITARUM unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the turn, that enemy unit cannot be targeted with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem and each time a GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army selects that enemy unit as a target of a charge, you can re-roll the Charge roll.
stratagems.legend: Disciplined salvoes of fire can drive the foe into cover, leaving them vulnerable to the rest of the cult.

stratagems.name: REGIMENTAL REINFORCEMENTS
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an Astra Militarum Infantry Regiment unit from your army (excluding Artillery and Character units) is destroyed.
stratagems.target: That INFANTRY unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Roll one D6: on a 3+, place one Cult Ambush marker anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" horizontally away from all enemy units (if this is not possible, no marker is placed) and add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Cult Ambush, at its Starting Strength, with all of its wounds remaining and any [ONE SHOT] weapons those models are equipped with considered as not having been shot.
stratagems.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.
stratagems.legend: Xeno-tainted soldiers have long learned to lurk in the shadows, ready to attack when the cult calls.

stratagems.name: IN THE SHADOW OF IRON
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit ends a move within 9" of one or more of your Cult Ambush markers.
stratagems.target: One Astra Militarum Vehicle unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one of those Cult Ambush markers. You can set up that Cult Ambush marker anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" horizontally away from all enemy units and wholly within 6" of your unit.
stratagems.legend: Hulking armoured war engines provide ideal cover to launch a well-timed ambush.

stratagems.name: LURKING MENACE
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the attacking model is not within 3", subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
stratagems.legend: Foes find their aim confounded as the Genestealer Cultists prowl through gloom and drifting steam, rarely presenting themselves as targets.

stratagems.name: FOR THE BROOD
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of one or more friendly GENESTEALER CULTS units. Until the end of the phase, your unit can make ranged attacks that target that enemy unit. If it does, after your unit has finished making those attacks, roll one D6 for each of those friendly units: on a 2-4, that friendly unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 5+, that friendly unit suffers 2 mortal wounds.
stratagems.legend: Fanatical, and with wills suborned by the insidious Broodmind, these cultists will gladly die amidst hails of their comrades'fire if it means victory.

stratagems.name: OUT OF HIDING
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, at the start of the Reinforcements step.
stratagems.target: One NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit from your army that is in Reserves.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Deep Strike ability.
stratagems.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once.
stratagems.legend: Wary of detection, the cult has concealed cells of the faithful through the structure of the ship. Now they emerge into the fight like insects from their cocoon.

stratagems.name: PLANNED EXTRACTION
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.legend: Driven by the Broodmind and their own guerrilla training, these cultists refuse open battle, instead firing hails of cover fire as they retreat into the shadows.

stratagems.name: DIVINE IMPERATIVE
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Genestealer Cults unit from your army that has not declared a charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of one or more Tyranids units from your army. Until the end of the phase, each time your GENESTEALER CULTS unit declares a charge, if that enemy unit is one of the targets of that charge, add 1 to Charge rolls made for your unit and you can re-roll the Charge roll.
stratagems.legend: Cultists dash madly into the fighting without a care for their survival, drawn onward to aid the vanguard organisms by a will they cannot resist.

stratagems.name: HYPERFEROCITY
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Genestealer Cults unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If one or more friendly Tyranids units are within 6" of that enemy unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.
stratagems.legend: Goaded by the newly ascendant Hive Mind, the cultists fight with greater fury even as their muscles tear and organs rupture under the strain.

stratagems.name: AVENGE THE STAR CHILDREN
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has shot or fought.
stratagems.target: One Tyranids Character unit from your army that was destroyed by that enemy unit this phase. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a Genestealer Cults model from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: Some amongst the cult still retain enough sentience and zeal to feel rage and a need for vengeance if they see the Star Children slain.

stratagems.name: DARTING ATTACKS
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Tyranids unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.legend: Like predatory sea beasts lunging from wheeling shoals of fish, the vanguard organisms strike and fade from amidst the cultist hordes repeatedly, picking apart their overwhelmed prey.

stratagems.name: PSI SURGE
stratagems.when: Start of any phase.
stratagems.target: One Tyranids unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, increase the range of your unit's Catalyst ability by 3".
stratagems.restrictions: Each time you use this Stratagem, until the end of your next Command phase, you cannot use this Stratagem again.
stratagems.legend: As the Tyranid invasion gathers pace, the influence of the Hive Mind surges like waves rolling ever higher onto a desolate shore.

stratagems.name: RESISTANCE TUNNELS
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Genestealer Cults or Tyranids unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.legend: Never again will the tunnel networks of the cult provide secret roads for hopeful and idealistic freedom fighters. Yet they can still serve one last time as a means by which the Tyranids and their surviving worshippers can vanish from the battlefield only to strike again elsewhere.

stratagems.name: UNSTOPPABLE BRUTES
stratagems.when: Your Movement or Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One ABOMINANT or ABERRANTS unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase and has not declared a charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, when makinga Normal, Advance or Charge move, your unit can move through a single closed Hatchway as if it was open. When doing so, that Hatchway is opened and cannot be closed for the rest of the battle. This can allow that unit to declare a charge against enemy units that are not visible to it, but to do so those enemy units must be within 1" of that Hatchway and wholly on the opposite side of it from your unit.
stratagems.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per turn.
stratagems.legend: Bulked out with enormous slabs of twisted muscle, Aberrants and Abominants simply smash aside hatches and bulkheads that block their paths.

stratagems.name: GROWING DREAD
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit is selected to perform a Tactical Manoeuvre.
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army that is within 9" of and visible to that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: That enemy unit must take a Leadership test, subtracting 1 from the result: if failed, that enemy unit does not perform that Tactical Manoeuvre and it cannot perform anotherTactical Manoeuvre this turn (but can otherwise act normally).
stratagems.legend: The more enemies see of the gene-wrought terrors they are fighting against, the more their tactical cohesion is drowned by horror and panic.

stratagems.name: MONSTROUS MOMENTUM
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after a GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
stratagems.target: That GENESTEALER CULTS unit.
stratagems.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, until the end of the phase, each time your unit Consolidates, models in your unit can end that move as close as possible to the nearest Hatchway instead of the nearest visible enemy unit. Your unit can then attempt to operate that Hatchway.
stratagems.legend: Not content with slaying their immediate prey, these warriors press on in search of more before the bodies have even stopped twitching.

stratagems.name: SOLDIERS OF THE STAR CHILDREN
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after a HYBRID METAMORPHS unit from your army is selected to perform the Set Overwatch Tactical Manoeuvre.
stratagems.target: That HYBRID METAMORPHS unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one objective marker you control that your unit is within range of. That objective marker is Secured by your army.
stratagems.legend: For all their grotesque appearance, Hybrid Metamorphs are amongst the most skilled and ruthlessly efficient of the cult's warriors.

stratagems.name: COORDINATED TRAP
stratagems.when: The start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: Two GENESTEALER CULTS units from your army that have not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit (if this Stratagem is used in the Fight phase, that enemy unit must be within Engagement Range of both of your units). Until the end of the phase, each time a model in either of your units makes an attack, it can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target for that attack), and when resolving that attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: A tenet of guerrilla warfare is the concentration of even inferior firepower to inflict maximum harm.

stratagems.name: PRIMED AND READIED
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS units from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+, instead of only a 6.
stratagems.legend: The broodkin have been trained and equipped for this moment, with weapons readied for Ascension.

stratagems.name: TUNNEL CRAWLERS
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.
stratagems.restrictions: A unit targeted by this Stratagem is not eligible to declare a charge in the same turn.
stratagems.legend: The cult can expertly assail seemingly impregnable enemy positions.

stratagems.name: RETURN TO THE SHADOWS
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Genestealer Cults Infantry unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.legend: With their task of drawing the oppressors' fire complete, the surviving cultists melt away, ready to strike again.

stratagems.name: LYING IN WAIT
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Genestealer Cults Battleline unit from your army in Cult Ambush.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, when setting your unit up using a Cult Ambush marker, set your unit up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 6" of that Cult Ambush marker and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.legend: The brood lurks invisibly as the enemy approaches. Not until the last second do they burst from cover to strike.

stratagems.name: A DEADLY SNARE
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit declares a charge.
stratagems.target: One Genestealer Cults Infantry unit from your army that was selected as a target of that charge.
stratagems.effect: Roll one D6: on a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 5+, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.
stratagems.legend: An enemy's fervour to strike down the faithful of the cult can be turned against them, luring the foe into a region laced with hidden traps and primed explosives.

stratagems.name: HYPERADRENAL REFLEXES
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One GREAT DEVOURER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
stratagems.legend: Goaded by the biostimulants surging through their bodies, these warrior organisms evade their enemies'attacks with unbelievable swiftness.

stratagems.name: HUNTING GROUNDS
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a GREAT DEVOURER unit from your army opens a Hatchway.
stratagems.target: That GREAT DEVOURER unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 3", provided at least one of its models ends that move on the opposite side of that Hatchway from when your unit opened it.
stratagems.legend: Genestealers on the hunt are relentless, squirming through hatches before they have even half opened.

stratagems.name: OUTFLANK
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALERs or PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit from your army that is wholly within an Entry Zone.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. It will arrive back on the battlefield in the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase. When doing so, if it was within one of your Entry Zones when it was removed, it must be set up wholly within another one of your Entry Zones. If it was within one of your opponent's Entry Zones when it was removed, it must be set up wholly within another one of your opponent's Entry Zones instead. If this is not possible, your unit is destroyed.
stratagems.legend: Swarms of Genestealers crawl through vents and ducts as they seek to outflank their prey.

stratagems.name: PERVASIVE DREAD
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after the enemy WARLORD is destroyed (and is not returned to the battlefield) by a GREAT DEVOURER unit from your army.
stratagems.target: That GREAT DEVOURER unit.
stratagems.effect: In your opponent's next Command phase, each enemy unit on the battlefield must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result. This Stratagem cannot cause a unit to take two Battle-shock tests in the same phase.
stratagems.legend: With the death of their leader, the surviving prey feel an ominous sense of doom press down upon them, heightened by subtle psionic assault.

stratagems.name: DEVOTED CREW
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Goliath Rockgrinder or Goliath Truck unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
stratagems.legend: With evasive manoeuvres and split-second repairs, Outlander Claws marshal their rugged vehicles through the worst the foe can throw at them.

stratagems.name: DEFT MANOEUVRING
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Achilles Ridgerunners or Atalan Jackals unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
stratagems.legend: Serpent-fast, jinking and swerving with incredible skill, the cult's light vehicles appear to slide through the oppressors' gunfire.

stratagems.name: CLOSE-RANGE SHOOT-OUT
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Genestealer Cults Mounted or Genestealer Cults Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability while targeting an enemy unit within 18".
stratagems.legend: A cult's experienced outriders are experts in hit-and-run attacks and close-range firefights. These skills are deadly when combined.

stratagems.name: ALONG SHADOWED TRAILS
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit ends a move within 9" of one or more of your Cult Ambush markers.
stratagems.target: Select one of those Cult Ambush markers.
stratagems.effect: You can set up that Cult Ambush marker anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" horizontally away from all enemy units.
stratagems.legend: With raw speed and subtle misdirection, Atalan Jackals outflank those who believe them trapped.

stratagems.name: RAPID FEINT
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One Achilles Ridgerunners or Atalan Jackals unit from your army that is within 9" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
stratagems.legend: An Outlander Claw's skilled riders and crews can use their enhanced hybrid reactions to rapidly alter speed and course, roaring after fleeing prey or luring enemy out of position and leaving them flat-footed.

stratagems.name: ENCIRCLING THE PREY
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Genestealer Cults Mounted or Genestealer Cults Vehicle unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and is wholly within 9" of one or more battlefield edges.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.legend: Skirting the edge of battle, an Outlander Claw's raiders watch keenly forvulnerabilities, ready to throw themselves back into the fight to exploit any weaknesses in the enemy.

stratagems.name: FRENZIED DEVOTION
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Acolyte Hybrids, Hybrid Metamorphs or Neophyte Hybrids unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Attacks and Weapon Skill characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models (excluding Characters) in your unit by 1 and those weapons have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.
stratagems.legend: The faithful will gladly hurl themselves into harm's way.frenziedly dragging the foe down.

stratagems.name: VENGEANCE FOR THE MARTYR!
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit destroys a Genestealer Cults Character model from your army.
stratagems.target: One other GENESTEALER CULTS CHARACTER model from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly Acolyte Hybrids, Hybrid Metamorphs or Neophyte Hybrids model makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If the destroyed model was a Magus, Primus or Acolyte Iconward, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.
stratagems.legend: Should one of the Patriarch's inner coven fall, those that remain are swift to call for lethal retribution.

stratagems.name: THE DOWNTRODDEN RISE
stratagems.when: End of the Reinforcements step of your opponent's Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Acolyte Hybrids, Hybrid Metamorphs or Neophyte Hybrids unit from your army in Cult Ambush.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, you can set up your unit on the battlefield without using a Cult Ambush marker. When doing so, set up your unit anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.
stratagems.legend: Such is the creed's inspirational call to arms that as the foe foil one incursion, another rises for the cause.

stratagems.name: TRANSCENDENT CELERITY
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Acolyte Hybrids, Hybrid Metamorphs or Neophyte Hybrids unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.
stratagems.legend: Owing to their hypersensory reactions, the cult's rate of fire increases.

stratagems.name: TIRELESS FERVOUR
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Acolyte Hybrids, Hybrid Metamorphs or Neophyte Hybrids unit from your army that has not declared a charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back. When doing so, if it targets an enemy unit within Engagement Range of one or more friendly Character units, you can re-roll the Charge roll.
stratagems.legend: When the cult's leaders demand devotion, danger and exhaustion are forgotten in the rush to serve.

stratagems.name: THE PATH OF ANGUISH
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One Acolyte Hybrids or Neophyte Hybrids unit from your army that had one or more of its models destroyed as a result of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a move of up to D6", but it unit must end that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT), When doing so, models in your unit can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
stratagems.legend: Bloody persecution by the oppressors is grist for the mill of the cult's violent and zealous creed.
